notes.author: watch-doggo
notes.body: **major** · The claim is checked after the row is written, so a failed check leaves a claimed domain behind.

notes.author: watch-doggo
notes.body: **minor** · The wrapped error drops the host, so a log line cannot say which domain failed.

notes.author: watch-doggo
notes.body: **blocker** · DELETE /domains/{id} is mounted before the auth middleware.
